title: IMPROVING PREGNANCY MANAGEMENT IN WOMEN WITH A HISTORY OF FOCAL MYOCARDITIS
summary: Background: Myocarditis is an inflammatory disease of the myocardium that may result in transient or persistent impairment of cardiac function. Women with a previous history of focal myocarditis require careful assessment before conception and individualized monitoring throughout pregnancy because physiological cardiovascular changes during pregnancy may increase the workload of the heart. Objective: To analyze the principles of pregnancy management in women who have previously experienced focal myocarditis and to identify approaches that may improve maternal and fetal outcomes. Materials and Methods: A review of contemporary clinical approaches to the management of women with a history of myocarditis was performed. Particular attention was paid to preconception assessment, electrocardiography, echocardiography, cardiac biomarkers, functional status, medication safety, and multidisciplinary follow-up during pregnancy. Results: Preconception cardiovascular assessment is essential for determining whether pregnancy can be safely undertaken. Left ventricular function, symptoms of heart failure, arrhythmias, residual myocardial dysfunction, and previous myocarditis complications should be considered. During pregnancy, regular clinical assessment, electrocardiography, echocardiography when indicated, and monitoring for signs of heart failure and arrhythmia can facilitate early recognition of complications. Cooperation between a cardiologist, obstetrician-gynecologist, and other specialists is particularly important in women with residual cardiac abnormalities. Conclusion: Individualized preconception counseling and multidisciplinary monitoring represent important components of pregnancy management after focal myocarditis. Assessment of ventricular function and clinical stability before conception, rational selection of medications, and timely recognition of cardiovascular complications may contribute to safer pregnancy outcomes.

title: Sudden Cardiac Death as the First Manifestation of Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy in a Young Female Athlete: Postmortem Morphologic Diagnosis
summary: We report a case of sudden cardiac death in a previously healthy 29-year-old female tennis player who collapsed during a family gathering with no prior cardiovascular symptoms and an unknown family history of sudden death or structural heart disease.A complete autopsy with histopathologic examination revealed a dilated right ventricle with wall thinning to 3 mm and focal transmural replacement of the myocardium by adipose tissue.Microscopically, the right ventricular wall consisted predominantly of adipose tissue, with small residual islands of hypertrophic cardiomyocytes, fibrosis, and sparse inflammatory infiltrates.A lateral left ventricular wall thickness of 15 mm, together with subepicardial fatty infiltration, prompted careful differential diagnostic consideration of athletic remodeling, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and biventricular or left-dominant phenotypes of arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy.Toxicologic analysis was negative.The postmortem gross and histopathologic findings fulfilled major morphologic and histologic criteria and were highly consistent with arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy; however, in the absence of premortem imaging, electrocardiographic, and genetic data, this should be regarded as a postmortem morphologic diagnosis rather than a complete multiparametric diagnosis.This case underscores the diagnostic value of systematic autopsy and histopathologic examination following sudden unexplained death in young athletes, the importance of cautious interpretation of concomitant left ventricular findings, and the need for cardiovascular and genetic evaluation of first-degree relatives.

title: Genetic and epigenetic landscape of non-familial sudden cardiac death.
summary: Sudden cardiac death (SCD) remains a major global health challenge, characterized by high incidence, low survival rates, and often presenting as the first manifestation of underlying disease. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the genetic and epigenetic landscape of non-familial SCD, emphasizing the multifactorial nature of this complex clinical endpoint. We summarize common single nucleotide polymorphisms and insertion/deletion variants associated with SCD, identified through candidate-gene-based studies and genome-wide association studies, highlighting risk variants clustered in genes involved in cardiovascular function, signal transduction, and cellular metabolism. We also describe the main epigenetic mechanisms - including microRNAs, DNA methylation, and histone modifications - that may contribute to SCD susceptibility and pathogenesis. Tissue-based and circulating microRNAs can act as mechanistic regulators of SCD pathogenesis and have emerged as exploratory biomarker candidates. However, inconsistent directions of association, methodological heterogeneity, and limited independent validation currently preclude their clinical application. DNA methylation studies, though scarce, suggest potential roles for imprinted genes and oxidative stress pathways. Histone modifications and chromatin remodeling represent underexplored but promising areas. We conclude that addressing the missing heritability of SCD and translating these molecular insights into clinical practice will require large-scale, integrative, and multi-ethnic studies combining genomic, epigenomic, and clinical data with functional validation.

title: Systems-Level in Silico Bioinformatic Profiling Identifies Key Hub Genes and Potential Therapeutic Targets in Atrial Fibrillation without Overt Comorbidity.
summary:
HIGHLIGHTS: Systems-level bioinformatics delineates the molecular architecture of AF without overt comorbidity.Network analysis reveals a highly interconnected ion-channel-centered interactome.DMNC topology prioritizes 10 mechanistically relevant hub genes governing atrial electrophysiology.Sodium and potassium channel modulators emerge as dominant drivers of arrhythmogenic susceptibility.These findings establish a molecular framework for precision stratification in isolated AF.

BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common sustained cardiac arrhythmia and is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality. AF occurring in individuals without structural heart disease or conventional risk factors, currently referred to as AF without overt comorbidity, remains poorly understood. Genetic susceptibility is thought to contribute, but the underlying molecular mechanisms are incompletely defined. This study aimed to identify key genes and biological processes associated with AF without overt comorbidity using an in-silico bioinformatics approach.

METHODS: Genes associated with AF without overt comorbidity were retrieved from the GeneCards database using a knowledge-based, database-driven strategy. Functional enrichment analysis of Gene Ontology biological processes was performed using WebGestalt. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) analysis was conducted using STRING and visualized in Cytoscape. Hub genes were identified exclusively using the Density of Maximum Neighborhood Component (DMNC) algorithm via the CytoHubba plugin. Three-dimensional protein structures of selected hub genes were modeled using SWISS-MODEL and evaluated using PROCHECK for exploratory structural characterization.

RESULTS: Eighty-one genes associated with AF without overt comorbidity were identified. PPI analysis demonstrated significant interaction enrichment (P<1.0×10-16), indicating a nonrandom and biologically coherent network. Functional enrichment analysis revealed cardiac muscle cell action potential and cardiac muscle contraction as the most significantly enriched biological processes. Ten hub genes were identified based on DMNC ranking. Among these, GPD1L, SCN1B, SCN4B, and KCNE2 showed central network positions and acceptable stereochemical quality in exploratory structural evaluation.

CONCLUSION: This in silico study identifies candidate genes and biological processes potentially involved in AF without overt comorbidity. The findings are hypothesis generating and warrant further functional and clinical validation.

summary_zh:
亮点：系统级生物信息学描绘了无显性合并症房颤的分子架构。网络分析揭示了一个高度互联的以离子通道为中心的相互作用组。DMNC拓扑学优先筛选出10个调控心房电生理的机制相关枢纽基因。钠和钾通道调节剂成为致心律失常易感性的主要驱动因素。这些发现为孤立性房颤的精准分层建立了分子框架。

背景：心房颤动（AF）是最常见的持续性心律失常，与显著的发病率和死亡率相关。发生于无结构性心脏病或传统危险因素个体的AF，目前称为无显性合并症房颤，仍知之甚少。遗传易感性被认为起一定作用，但潜在分子机制尚未完全明确。本研究旨在利用计算机生物信息学方法识别与无显性合并症房颤相关的关键基因和生物学过程。

方法：采用基于知识、数据库驱动的策略从GeneCards数据库检索与无显性合并症房颤相关的基因。使用WebGestalt进行基因本体生物学过程的功能富集分析。使用STRING进行蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）分析，并在Cytoscape中可视化。仅通过CytoHubba插件使用最大邻域分量密度（DMNC）算法识别枢纽基因。使用SWISS-MODEL对所选枢纽基因的三维蛋白质结构进行建模，并使用PROCHECK进行评估以进行探索性结构表征。

结果：共识别出81个与无显性合并症房颤相关的基因。PPI分析显示显著的相互作用富集（P<1.0×10-16），表明网络非随机且具有生物学一致性。功能富集分析揭示心肌细胞动作电位和心肌收缩是最显著富集的生物学过程。基于DMNC排名识别出10个枢纽基因。其中，GPD1L、SCN1B、SCN4B和KCNE2显示出中心网络位置，并在探索性结构评估中具有可接受的立体化学质量。

结论：本计算机研究识别了可能参与无显性合并症房颤的候选基因和生物学过程。这些发现具有假设生成性，值得进一步的功能和临床验证。

title: The silent storm: Quinine-induced Torsade de Pointes unmasking a latent KCNH2 variant.
summary: Quinine, a Cinchona alkaloid and a cornerstone of malaria therapy in resource-limited settings, produces predominant sodium-channel blockade alongside modest inhibition of the rapid delayed-rectifier potassium current (IKr). Although generally safe at the population level, even modest IKr blockade can precipitate life-threatening Torsade de Pointes (TdP) in patients with severely impaired repolarization reserve. We report an 8-year-old boy with severe Plasmodium falciparum malaria who, on the third day of intravenous quinine, developed profound QTc prolongation (730 ms) followed by recurrent TdP. This arose from the convergence of quinine-induced IKr inhibition, hypokalaemia (K 2.9 mmol/L), and an underlying pathogenic KCNH2 variant, which together exhausted repolarization reserve. Although initially haemodynamically stable, the patient's extreme electrical instability proved a sentinel event, prompting identification of latent Long QT Syndrome type 2 (LQT2). The case highlights the importance of ECG monitoring and electrolyte correction during quinine therapy. It illustrates how drug-induced arrhythmia can represent the phenotypic unmasking of diminished repolarization reserve, in which a pharmacological trigger exposes a silent genetic substrate-here necessitating lifelong beta-blocker therapy and family cascade screening to prevent sudden cardiac death.

AI.tldr: 8岁重症疟疾男孩静脉奎宁第3天出现QTc延长至730ms并反复尖端扭转性室速，揭示隐匿性KCNH2相关LQT2，需终身β受体阻滞剂及家系筛查。
AI.motivation: 奎宁是资源有限地区疟疾治疗的基石，虽以钠通道阻滞为主，但对IKr有轻度抑制；既往认为群体水平安全，但严重复极储备受损者即使轻度IKr抑制也可能诱发致命性TdP。本研究旨在通过一例奎宁诱发TdP的病例，揭示药物触发下隐匿遗传基质（KCNH2变异）的显现，弥补对药物-基因交互致心律失常风险认识的不足。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为1例8岁重症恶性疟疾男孩，接受静脉奎宁治疗；观察用药期间心电图QTc变化及TdP发作情况，结合血钾水平及基因检测结果进行病因分析。主要终点为奎宁治疗期间QTc延长及TdP发作；次要终点为潜在遗传变异鉴定及家系筛查。统计方法：摘要未报告。
AI.result: 静脉奎宁第3天出现QTc显著延长至730 ms，随后反复发作TdP；合并低钾血症（K 2.9 mmol/L）；基因检测发现致病性KCNH2变异，诊断为隐匿性LQT2。尽管初期血流动力学稳定，但极端电不稳定性成为警示事件。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: 奎宁诱导的TdP可暴露隐匿性复极储备降低，即药物触发揭示沉默遗传基质（KCNH2变异相关LQT2）。临床启示：奎宁治疗期间应加强心电图监测和电解质纠正；对药物诱发心律失常患者应进行遗传评估，确诊LQT2者需终身β受体阻滞剂治疗及家系级联筛查以预防心源性猝死。局限性为单例病例报告，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh: 奎宁是一种金鸡纳生物碱，也是资源有限地区疟疾治疗的基石，其主要产生钠通道阻滞，同时轻度抑制快速延迟整流钾电流（IKr）。尽管在人群水平上总体安全，但即使轻度的IKr阻滞，在复极储备严重受损的患者中也可能诱发危及生命的尖端扭转型室性心动过速（TdP）。我们报告一名患有严重恶性疟原虫疟疾的8岁男孩，在静脉注射奎宁的第三天出现显著的QTc延长（730 ms），随后反复发生TdP。这是由奎宁诱导的IKr抑制、低钾血症（K 2.9 mmol/L）和潜在的致病性KCNH2变异共同作用所致，三者共同耗竭了复极储备。尽管患者最初血流动力学稳定，但其极端的电不稳定性被证明是一个前哨事件，促使发现了潜在的长QT综合征2型（LQT2）。本病例强调了奎宁治疗期间心电图监测和电解质纠正的重要性。它说明了药物诱导的心律失常如何代表复极储备减低的表型揭示，其中药理触发因素暴露了沉默的遗传基质——此处需要终身β受体阻滞剂治疗和家族级联筛查以预防心源性猝死。

title: Genetically Predicted Gut Microbial Taxa and Inflammatory Proteins Associated With Atrial Fibrillation: A Bidirectional Mendelian Randomization and Colocalization Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Observational studies have linked the gut microbiota and inflammatory proteins to atrial fibrillation (AF), but confounding, reverse causation, and instrument validity remain concerns.

METHODS: We evaluated 473 microbial traits and 91 inflammatory proteins in relation to AF using two GWAS datasets. Sensitivity analyses included instruments selected at p < 5 × 10-8, MR-RAPS, cis/trans-stratified protein MR, reverse MR, and FGF-5 colocalization. Participants were predominantly of European ancestry.

RESULTS: Under conventional IVW analysis, six associations were FDR-significant in the discovery analysis and remained FDR-significant when selectively evaluated in the second AF GWAS, with FDR correction applied across the six prioritized tests: Leptospirae (OR 0.605, 95% CI 0.457-0.800), Leptospirales (0.499, 0.371-0.673), leukemia inhibitory factor receptor (LIF-R; 0.905, 0.869-0.943), TWEAK (0.891, 0.856-0.927), FGF-5 (1.077, 1.051-1.103), and interleukin-6 (0.886, 0.834-0.942). At p < 5 × 10-8, neither microbial trait had a harmonized instrument, whereas the protein estimates retained their directions. MR-RAPS supported LIF-R in both datasets, but support for the other signals varied. The prioritized proteins also differed in cis/trans genetic architecture. The FGF-5 cis-only estimates were based on two harmonized instruments and were therefore preliminary, while cis-region colocalization provided little evidence of a shared variant (PP.H4 = 0.0045).

CONCLUSIONS: The conventional IVW associations varied in robustness across alternative analyses. These findings prioritize hypotheses, not established causal pathways or clinical targets. Generalizability beyond predominantly European populations remains uncertain.

AI.tldr: 双向孟德尔随机化研究提示部分肠道菌群分类群和炎症蛋白与房颤存在关联，但稳健性不一，FGF-5关联证据不足，结果仅具假设生成意义。
AI.motivation: 观察性研究提示肠道菌群和炎症蛋白与房颤相关，但存在混杂、反向因果和工具变量效度问题，既往证据因果性不明确。
AI.method: 采用双向孟德尔随机化及共定位研究，基于两个全欧洲血统为主的GWAS数据集，评估473个微生物性状和91个炎症蛋白与房颤的关联；敏感性分析包括p<5×10⁻⁸工具变量筛选、MR-RAPS、顺式/反式分层蛋白MR、反向MR和FGF-5共定位。
AI.result: 常规IVW分析发现6个关联在发现集中FDR显著，并在第二个房颤GWAS中经FDR校正后仍显著：Leptospirae（OR 0.605，95%CI 0.457-0.800）、Leptospirales（0.499，0.371-0.673）、LIF-R（0.905，0.869-0.943）、TWEAK（0.891，0.856-0.927）、FGF-5（1.077，1.051-1.103）和IL-6（0.886，0.834-0.942）。在p<5×10⁻⁸阈值下，微生物性状无 harmonized 工具变量，蛋白估计方向保持不变；MR-RAPS在两个数据集中支持LIF-R，其他信号支持不一；FGF-5顺式估计仅基于两个工具变量，共定位证据不足（PP.H4=0.0045）。
AI.conclusion: 常规IVW关联在不同分析中稳健性各异，这些发现仅优先提出假设，而非确立因果通路或临床靶点；对欧洲以外人群的普适性尚不确定。

summary_zh:
背景：观察性研究已将肠道微生物群和炎症蛋白与心房颤动（AF）联系起来，但混杂因素、反向因果和工具变量有效性仍是问题。

方法：我们使用两个GWAS数据集评估了473种微生物特征和91种炎症蛋白与AF的关系。敏感性分析包括在p < 5 × 10-8水平选择的工具变量、MR-RAPS、顺式/反式分层蛋白MR、反向MR和FGF-5共定位。参与者主要为欧洲血统。

结果：在常规IVW分析下，发现分析中有六个关联具有FDR显著性，并且在第二个AF GWAS中选择性评估时仍保持FDR显著性，FDR校正应用于六个优先测试：Leptospirae（OR 0.605，95% CI 0.457-0.800）、Leptospirales（0.499，0.371-0.673）、白血病抑制因子受体（LIF-R；0.905，0.869-0.943）、TWEAK（0.891，0.856-0.927）、FGF-5（1.077，1.051-1.103）和白细胞介素-6（0.886，0.834-0.942）。在p < 5 × 10-8水平，两种微生物特征均无协调工具变量，而蛋白质估计值保留了其方向。MR-RAPS在两个数据集中均支持LIF-R，但对其他信号的支持程度不一。优先蛋白质在顺式/反式遗传结构上也有所不同。FGF-5仅顺式估计基于两个协调工具变量，因此是初步的，而顺式区域共定位提供的共享变异证据很少（PP.H4 = 0.0045）。

结论：常规IVW关联在替代分析中的稳健性各不相同。这些发现优先考虑的是假设，而非已确定的因果通路或临床靶点。在主要为欧洲人群之外的普遍性仍不确定。

title: Do Stimulants Promote Arrhythmic Risk: Insights From a Human-Induced Pluripotent Stem Cell-Derived Cardiomyocyte Model.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Stimulant medications are widely prescribed for ADHD. Although generally considered safe, their use in patients with underlying cardiac conditions remains a concern due to potential arrhythmic risk.

OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the effects of commonly prescribed stimulants on key electrophysiological parameters associated with arrhythmia risk in chamber-specific human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs).

METHODS: Atrial and ventricular hiPSC-CMs were plated on a multielectrode array (MEA) platform and exposed to clinically relevant plasma concentrations of methylphenidate, dextroamphetamine, atomoxetine, caffeine, or the β-agonist isoproterenol. Extracellular field potentials were recorded over 48 h to assess acute and prolonged effects on conduction velocity (CV), beat rate (BR), and corrected field potential duration (FPDc).

RESULTS: CV was largely preserved across all stimulant conditions in both atrial and ventricular hiPSC-CMs, while isoproterenol produced a modest early increase. All stimulants transiently elevated BR during the first hour of exposure, followed by a progressive decline over time. Isoproterenol and caffeine induced robust and sustained increases in BR, confirming model responsiveness. FPDc was prolonged by all stimulant compounds, most prominently by atomoxetine, consistent with its known IKr inhibitory properties. Isoproterenol produced a rate-dependent FPDc shortening, particularly in hiPSC-vCMs.

CONCLUSION: At clinically relevant plasma concentrations, stimulants modulated automaticity and repolarization but had minimal impact on conduction in hiPSC-CMs. The preservation of CV suggests that these compounds are unlikely to alter myocardial conduction at therapeutic doses. The observed effects on BR and FPDc warrant further mechanistic studies to understand how these changes may contribute to arrhythmia risk in susceptible populations.

AI.tldr: 在临床相关血浆浓度下，哌甲酯、右苯丙胺、托莫西汀和咖啡因对hiPSC-CMs的传导速度影响极小，但可调节自律性和复极，提示治疗剂量下致心律失常风险主要源于复极和自律性改变而非传导异常。
AI.motivation: 兴奋剂药物广泛用于ADHD治疗，虽总体安全，但合并基础心脏病的患者使用时的致心律失常风险尚不明确，缺乏人类心肌细胞层面的电生理证据。
AI.method: 研究采用心房和心室hiPSC-CMs接种于多电极阵列平台，暴露于临床相关血浆浓度的哌甲酯、右苯丙胺、托莫西汀、咖啡因或β受体激动剂异丙肾上腺素，记录48小时细胞外场电位，评估传导速度、搏动频率和校正场电位时限的急性和长期变化。
AI.result: 所有兴奋剂条件下心房和心室hiPSC-CMs的传导速度基本保持不变，异丙肾上腺素仅引起早期轻度增加。所有兴奋剂在暴露第一小时短暂升高搏动频率，随后逐渐下降；异丙肾上腺素和咖啡因引起持续而显著的搏动频率增加。所有兴奋剂均延长校正场电位时限，以托莫西汀最为明显，与其已知的IKr抑制作用一致。异丙肾上腺素引起频率依赖性校正场电位时限缩短，在心室hiPSC-CMs中尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 在临床相关血浆浓度下，兴奋剂主要调节自律性和复极，对传导影响极小，提示治疗剂量下这些药物不太可能改变心肌传导；搏动频率和校正场电位时限的变化需进一步机制研究，以明确其在易感人群中如何贡献致心律失常风险。

summary_zh:
背景：兴奋剂药物被广泛用于ADHD的处方治疗。尽管通常被认为安全，但由于潜在的心律失常风险，其在有基础心脏疾病的患者中的使用仍令人担忧。

目的：评估常用处方兴奋剂对与心律失常风险相关的关键电生理参数的影响，研究对象为腔室特异性的人诱导多能干细胞来源心肌细胞（hiPSC-CMs）。

方法：将心房和心室hiPSC-CMs接种于多电极阵列（MEA）平台，并暴露于临床相关血浆浓度的哌甲酯、右苯丙胺、托莫西汀、咖啡因或β受体激动剂异丙肾上腺素。记录细胞外场电位48小时，以评估对传导速度（CV）、搏动频率（BR）和校正场电位时长（FPDc）的急性和长期影响。

结果：在心房和心室hiPSC-CMs中，所有兴奋剂条件下的CV基本保持不变，而异丙肾上腺素引起早期适度增加。所有兴奋剂在暴露的第一小时内短暂升高BR，随后随时间逐渐下降。异丙肾上腺素和咖啡因诱导了强劲且持续的BR增加，证实了模型反应性。所有兴奋剂化合物均延长FPDc，其中托莫西汀最为显著，与其已知的IKr抑制特性一致。异丙肾上腺素产生频率依赖性FPDc缩短，尤其在hiPSC-vCMs中。

结论：在临床相关血浆浓度下，兴奋剂调节了hiPSC-CMs的自律性和复极，但对传导影响极小。CV的保持表明这些化合物在治疗剂量下不太可能改变心肌传导。观察到的对BR和FPDc的影响需要进一步的机制研究，以了解这些变化如何可能促成易感人群的心律失常风险。

title: Gene-Tiered Interpretation of Sarcomere VUS Refines Risk Stratification in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The clinical significance of sarcomere variants of uncertain significance (VUS) in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) remains unclear. Despite their increasing prevalence, VUS are often regarded as clinically nonactionable.

OBJECTIVES: The authors evaluated genotype-phenotype and genotype-outcome associations by variant pathogenicity, focusing on gene-tiered sarcomere VUS in an Asian HCM cohort.

METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 438 Korean patients with HCM undergoing targeted genetic testing. Patients were categorized by sarcomere variant status: no sarcomere variant, VUS in genes with limited evidence (nondef9), VUS in genes with definitive HCM evidence (def9), and pathogenic or likely pathogenic (P/LP) in the sarcomere panel. We compared clinical and imaging phenotypes, and a composite endpoint of major adverse cardiovascular events, using Firth-penalized Cox models.

RESULTS: P/LP variants were identified in 163 of 438 patients (37.2%), and def9 and nondef9 VUS in 83 (18.9%) and 85 (19.4%) patients, respectively. def9 VUS carriers exhibited intermediate phenotypic and prognostic features between P/LP and genotype-negative patients, whereas nondef9 VUS carriers clinically resembled genotype-negative HCM. During a median follow-up of 6.4 years (IQR: 2.7-10.7 years), the primary endpoint occurred in 29 of 438 patients (6.6%). Modeled as an ordinal variable across these 4 groups, the classification showed a stepwise increase in risk of the primary endpoint (HR: 1.62; 95% CI: 1.08-2.63; P = 0.019), which was unchanged after adjustment for family history of HCM and maximum left ventricular wall thickness.

CONCLUSIONS: Sarcomere VUS do not represent a homogeneous category. Gene-tier stratification may refine variant interpretation and clinical management in HCM, particularly in populations under-represented in current variant databases.

AI.tldr: 在韩国肥厚型心肌病队列中，根据基因证据等级分层，def9基因的VUS携带者表型和预后介于P/LP突变与基因阴性患者之间，而nondef9基因的VUS携带者与基因阴性者相似，基因分层可细化风险分层。
AI.motivation: 肥厚型心肌病中肌节基因的VUS临床意义不明，常被视为不可操作，但VUS检出率增加，需要评估其基因型-表型和基因型-结局关联，尤其在亚洲人群中。
AI.method: 回顾性分析438例接受靶向基因检测的韩国HCM患者，按肌节变异状态分为四组：无变异、nondef9基因VUS、def9基因VUS、P/LP变异。比较临床和影像表型，主要终点为主要不良心血管事件复合终点，采用Firth惩罚Cox模型。
AI.result: P/LP变异163例(37.2%)，def9 VUS 83例(18.9%)，nondef9 VUS 85例(19.4%)。中位随访6.4年，主要终点发生29例(6.6%)。按四组有序变量建模，主要终点风险呈阶梯式增加(HR 1.62, 95%CI 1.08-2.63, P=0.019)，调整家族史和最大左室壁厚度后不变。
AI.conclusion: 肌节VUS并非同质类别，基因分层可细化变异解读和临床管理，尤其在变异数据库代表性不足的人群中。

summary_zh:
背景：肥厚型心肌病（HCM）中肌节意义未明变异（VUS）的临床意义仍不明确。尽管其检出率不断增加，VUS 常被视为临床不可干预。

目的：作者在亚洲 HCM 队列中按变异致病性评估基因型-表型和基因型-结局关联，重点关注基因分层后的肌节 VUS。

方法：我们回顾性分析了 438 例接受靶向基因检测的韩国 HCM 患者。按肌节变异状态对患者进行分类：无肌节变异、证据有限基因中的 VUS（nondef9）、具有明确 HCM 证据基因中的 VUS（def9），以及肌节 panel 中的致病或可能致病（P/LP）变异。我们比较了临床和影像学表型，并使用 Firth 惩罚 Cox 模型比较主要不良心血管事件的复合终点。

结果：438 例患者中 163 例（37.2%）检出 P/LP 变异，def9 和 nondef9 VUS 分别见于 83 例（18.9%）和 85 例（19.4%）患者。def9 VUS 携带者的表型和预后特征介于 P/LP 与基因型阴性患者之间，而 nondef9 VUS 携带者在临床上与基因型阴性 HCM 相似。在中位随访 6.4 年（IQR：2.7-10.7 年）期间，438 例患者中 29 例（6.6%）发生主要终点。将这 4 组作为有序变量建模，该分类显示主要终点风险呈阶梯式增加（HR：1.62；95% CI：1.08-2.63；P = 0.019），在调整 HCM 家族史和最大左心室壁厚度后该结果不变。

结论：肌节 VUS 并非一个同质类别。基因分层可能优化 HCM 的变异解读和临床管理，尤其是在当前变异数据库代表性不足的人群中。

title: Low Energy Bipolar Radiofrequency Ablation Combined With a Needle Electrode Connected in a Parallel Electrical Circuit to Create an Isolated Intramyocardial Lesion.
summary:
BACKGROUND: An ideal ablation method to create lesions inside the thick myocardium has not been well established. This experimental study was performed to assess whether low energy bipolar (BIP) radiofrequency (RF) ablation combined with a needle electrode can create an isolated intramyocardial lesion with minimum risk of steam-pop.

METHODS: A coronary perfused porcine myocardial segment was placed in an experimental setting, and two irrigation catheters were placed on the opposite endocardial and epicardial surfaces. An originally made plastic needle (equipped with a 3-mm electrode tip and a temperature sensor) was inserted into the middle myocardial region, approximately in line with and centered between the two ablation catheters. Cable-ends of the epicardial catheter and the plastic needle electrode were together plugged into the cutaneous electrode connector, whereas the cable-end of the endocardial catheter was plugged into the catheter connector of the generator. 10 W for either 60 or 90 s (18 applications each) was delivered simultaneously between the distal tips of the two ablation catheters and between the needle electrode and the endocardial ablation catheter.

RESULTS: All 36 applications were successfully accomplished without steam-pop, and created an isolated intramyocardial lesion. Vertical/horizontal lesion diameters and maximum intramyocardial temperature were 7.3 ± 0.8/6.3 ± 0.7 mm and 87.9°C ± 6.2°C in the 60-second, and 9.1 ± 1.0/8.0 ± 1.1 mm and 95.6°C ± 4.7°C in the 90-second applications. No visual lesion was created on the myocardial surface.

CONCLUSIONS: Although the present study is a first step in this ablation method, BIP ablation combined with a needle electrode may have the potential to create an isolated intramural lesion with minimum risk of steam-pop under local temperature monitoring.

AI.tldr: 在离体猪心肌模型中，低能量双极射频消融联合针电极可安全创建孤立的心肌内病灶，无蒸汽爆裂风险，且表面无损伤。
AI.motivation: 厚心肌内理想消融方法尚未确立，现有技术难以在心肌内创建孤立病灶且存在蒸汽爆裂风险，本研究旨在评估低能量双极射频消融联合针电极的可行性。
AI.method: 实验研究，采用冠状动脉灌注的猪心肌段，在内外膜表面各放置冲洗导管，将自制塑料针电极（3mm电极头带温度传感器）插入心肌中层，与心外膜导管电缆共同连接皮肤电极连接器，心内膜导管连接发生器。以10W功率分别消融60秒或90秒（各18次），同时于两消融导管远端之间及针电极与心内膜消融导管之间放电。终点为病灶形成及蒸汽爆裂发生。
AI.result: 36次消融均成功完成，无蒸汽爆裂，均创建孤立心肌内病灶。60秒组垂直/水平病灶直径7.3±0.8/6.3±0.7 mm，心肌内最高温度87.9±6.2°C；90秒组分别为9.1±1.0/8.0±1.1 mm和95.6±4.7°C。心肌表面未见肉眼病灶。
AI.conclusion: 低能量双极射频消融联合针电极在局部温度监测下可创建孤立心肌内病灶，蒸汽爆裂风险低，但本研究为初步实验，临床有效性和安全性需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：在厚心肌内部制造损伤的理想消融方法尚未充分建立。本实验研究旨在评估低能量双极（BIP）射频（RF）消融联合针电极是否能以最低的蒸汽爆裂（steam-pop）风险产生孤立的心肌内损伤。

方法：将冠状动脉灌注的猪心肌段置于实验装置中，并将两根灌注射频消融导管分别置于相对的心内膜和心外膜表面。将一根自制的塑料针（配备3 mm电极尖端和温度传感器）插入心肌中部区域，大致与两根消融导管成一直线并位于两者中心。将心外膜导管和塑料针电极的缆线端一起插入皮肤电极连接器，而心内膜导管的缆线端插入发生器的导管连接器。以10 W功率分别持续60秒或90秒（各18次应用），同时在两支消融导管远端尖端之间以及针电极与心内膜消融导管之间施加能量。

结果：所有36次应用均成功完成，无蒸汽爆裂，并产生孤立的心肌内损伤。在60秒应用中，垂直/水平损伤直径和最大心肌内温度分别为7.3 ± 0.8/6.3 ± 0.7 mm和87.9°C ± 6.2°C；在90秒应用中分别为9.1 ± 1.0/8.0 ± 1.1 mm和95.6°C ± 4.7°C。心肌表面未见肉眼可见的损伤。

结论：尽管本研究是该消融方法的第一步，但BIP消融联合针电极在局部温度监测下可能有潜力以最低的蒸汽爆裂风险产生孤立的心肌内损伤。

title: Factors Associated with Arrhythmia in Patients with ST Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction: A Single-Center Cross-Sectional Study.
summary:
HIGHLIGHTS: Arrhythmia occurred in 26.5% of hospitalized STEMI patients in this cohort.Higher Killip class, TIMI, GRACE, reduced TAPSE, renal dysfunction, and hyperkalemia were associated with arrhythmia in unadjusted analysis.After multivariable adjustment, Killip class was the only independent predictor of in-hospital arrhythmia.Killip class I reduced arrhythmic risk by around 60% compared with higher classes.

BACKGROUND: Arrhythmia is a common and clinically significant complication during hospitalization for ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI). This study aimed to identify factors associated with the occurrence of arrhythmia in the acute phase of STEMI.

METHODS: This single-center cross-sectional study was conducted among adult patients hospitalized with STEMI. Demographic and clinical variables, including cardiovascular risk factors and disease severity (Killip class, Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction [TIMI] score, and Global Registry of Acute Coronary Events [GRACE] score), were obtained from medical records. The primary outcome was in-hospital arrhythmia, defined as documented atrial or ventricular tachyarrhythmia or clinically significant bradyarrhythmia. Factors associated with arrhythmia were assessed using bivariate analyses followed by multivariable logistic regression.

RESULTS: This study involved 113 patients, with a mean age of 56.4 (11.1) years. Arrhythmia occurred in 26.5% (30 patients) during hospitalization. In bivariate analyses, arrhythmia was associated with higher Killip class (P<0.001), higher TIMI score (P=0.005), higher GRACE score (P=0.001), lower tricuspid annular plane systolic excursion (P=0.002), elevated serum potassium level (P=0.010), and impaired renal function, reflected by higher urea (P=0.005) and creatinine levels (P=0.004). After multivariable adjustment, only Killip class remained independently associated with arrhythmia: patients presenting with Killip class I had a significantly lower risk of arrhythmia than those with higher Killip classes (adjusted OR, 0.404; 95% CI, 0.20 to 0.80; P=0.009).

CONCLUSION: In hospitalized patients with STEMI, arrhythmic risk is chiefly driven by early clinical severity. Killip class is a simple bedside predictor of in-hospital arrhythmia and can aid early risk stratification and monitoring.

AI.tldr: 住院STEMI患者中26.5%发生心律失常，多因素校正后仅Killip分级是独立预测因子，Killip I级患者风险降低约60%。
AI.motivation: 心律失常是STEMI急性期常见且具有临床意义的并发症，但既往证据对哪些因素独立驱动住院期间心律失常发生尚不明确，本研究旨在识别与STEMI急性期心律失常相关的因素。
AI.method: 单中心横断面研究，纳入113例住院成人STEMI患者，从病历获取人口学、心血管危险因素及病情严重程度（Killip分级、TIMI评分、GRACE评分）等变量；主要终点为住院期间心律失常，定义为记录到的房性或室性快速性心律失常或临床显著的心动过缓；采用双变量分析及多因素logistic回归评估相关因素。
AI.result: 患者平均年龄56.4（11.1）岁，住院期间26.5%（30例）发生心律失常。双变量分析显示心律失常与较高Killip分级（P<0.001）、较高TIMI评分（P=0.005）、较高GRACE评分（P=0.001）、较低三尖瓣环收缩期位移（P=0.002）、血钾升高（P=0.010）及肾功能受损（尿素P=0.005、肌酐P=0.004）相关。多因素校正后，仅Killip分级与心律失常独立相关：Killip I级患者风险显著低于更高分级者（校正OR 0.404，95%CI 0.20-0.80，P=0.009）。
AI.conclusion: 住院STEMI患者心律失常风险主要由早期临床严重程度驱动，Killip分级是简便的床旁预测指标，有助于早期风险分层和监测；但本研究为单中心横断面设计、样本量较小，结论需更大规模前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
亮点：在本队列中，26.5%的住院STEMI患者发生了心律失常。在未调整分析中，较高的Killip分级、TIMI评分、GRACE评分、TAPSE降低、肾功能不全和高钾血症与心律失常相关。经过多变量调整后，Killip分级是院内心律失常的唯一独立预测因素。与较高分级相比，Killip I级使心律失常风险降低约60%。

背景：心律失常是ST段抬高型心肌梗死（STEMI）住院期间常见且具有临床意义的并发症。本研究旨在识别与STEMI急性期心律失常发生相关的因素。

方法：这项单中心横断面研究在因STEMI住院的成年患者中进行。从医疗记录中获取人口统计学和临床变量，包括心血管危险因素和疾病严重程度（Killip分级、心肌梗死溶栓治疗[TIMI]评分和全球急性冠状动脉事件注册[GRACE]评分）。主要结局是院内心律失常，定义为记录到的房性或室性快速性心律失常或具有临床意义的心动过缓性心律失常。通过双变量分析随后进行多变量逻辑回归评估与心律失常相关的因素。

结果：本研究纳入113例患者，平均年龄56.4（11.1）岁。住院期间26.5%（30例患者）发生心律失常。在双变量分析中，心律失常与较高的Killip分级（P<0.001）、较高的TIMI评分（P=0.005）、较高的GRACE评分（P=0.001）、较低的三尖瓣环收缩期位移（P=0.002）、血清钾水平升高（P=0.010）以及肾功能受损（表现为较高的尿素（P=0.005）和肌酐水平（P=0.004））相关。经过多变量调整后，仅Killip分级与心律失常保持独立相关：表现为Killip I级的患者发生心律失常的风险显著低于Killip分级较高的患者（调整OR，0.404；95% CI，0.20至0.80；P=0.009）。

结论：在住院STEMI患者中，心律失常风险主要由早期临床严重程度驱动。Killip分级是院内心律失常的简单床旁预测因素，可有助于早期风险分层和监测。
